title: CS2 World Bundle derived cache manifest (derived/derived.json)
description: Written by `python -m csiibundle.bake`. Not a producer layer and not part of the bundle contract's compatibility promise (bundle-schema.md §13). Records what was baked, against which bundle, from which inputs, so a consumer can tell a fresh product from a stale one per product.

bakeVersion.description: Version of the bake's own outputs. A consumer that reads a product must check it; a differing bakeVersion makes every product stale.

csiibundleSchema.description: The bundle contract version the bake understands (bundle-schema.md §12).

generatedAt.description: When the bake finished, ISO 8601 UTC.

bundle.description: Identity of the bundle the products were baked from.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of bundle.json's bytes at bake time.

generatedAt.description: The bundle manifest's own generatedAt at bake time.

options.description: The options that shaped the outputs. Two bakes with different options are different caches; a consumer that needs a specific option value must check it here.

tile.description: Tile edge in bundle-frame metres, grid anchored at (0, 0).

diagonal.description: Heightfield triangulation assumed when conforming to the terrain.

region.description: Absent or null for a full-bundle bake; otherwise the bundle-frame disc the products were limited to.

products.description: One entry per product that was baked. Absent product = not baked. Keys are the product names of bundle-schema.md §13.

fingerprint.description: What an input layer looked like at bake time. A file carries size + mtimeNs; a directory carries count + bytes + maxMtimeNs + a SHA-256 over its sorted relative file names.

path.description: Relative to the derived directory: a file, or a directory (trailing slash).

seconds.description: Wall-clock the product took to bake.

inputs.description: Fingerprint of every bundle layer this product was computed from, keyed by the manifest layer key (bundle.json `layers`).

tiles.description: For tiled products: the [tx, tz] tile indices that were written (files named <product>_<tx>_<tz>.glb).

stats.description: Product-specific counters (vertices, queries, draped, missed, ...). Informational.
